title: PAR-03 XDATA 1006-1009 and XRECORD type-context audit
mode: source-backed local implementation with generated fast tests
scope: Reconcile current and historical Autodesk group-code references for 1006-1009
Keep unresolved standalone binary widths fail-closed while retaining an explicit historical compatibility profile
Align XRECORD-specific handle and point mappings with its ODA-described group-code payload context
Refuse typed XRECORD values whose group code has no supported payload mapping and retain bounded unknown parsed blocks for exact same-version replay

autodeskGroupCodeValueTypes2024.finding: The table lists 1000-1003 as strings, 1004 as a binary chunk, 1005 as a string handle, and then starts the next assigned range at 1010.

autodeskGroupCodesNumerical2025.finding: The numerical reference identifies XDATA codes through 1005 and resumes at 1010; its preamble says non-fixed meanings depend on context.

odaDwgSpecification.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, local copy /Users/dli/doc/dwg/OpenDesign_Specification_for_.dwg_files (1).pdf
odaDwgSpecification.finding: XRECORD data are DXF group-code/value pairs; code 1005 is described as an entity-handle reference.

evidence.decision: The source conflict is preserved. Codes 1006-1009 remain Unknown in the standalone-safe classifier; only the explicit LibreCadMasterLegacy profile retains the earlier string-width interpretation. No producer-specific type is inferred.

changes.classifier: src/intern/dxfcode.h splits code 1005 from 1006-1009 and keeps 1006-1009 Unknown by default; the explicit legacy profile maps 1006-1009 to strings.
changes.xrecord: src/drw_objects.cpp limits XRECORD entity-handle values to code 1005, point groups to 210-239, and refuses unsupported typed output instead of emitting a code with zero payload bytes.
generatedTests: tests/wave1_tests.cpp verifies standalone 1006/1009 unknown handling, ASCII spelling retention, binary write/read refusal, and legacy-profile string behavior.

tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp and tests/xrecord_test_helpers.h verify XRECORD codes 1009 and 240 remain bounded opaque data and replay only under exact same-version provenance; typed output rejects those codes and accepts 1005.
tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp and tests/hardening_tests.cpp update their independent binary DXF string-code maps to identify only code 1005, not 1005-1009.
changes.plan: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md records the documentation conflict, exact evidence ceiling, completed fast slice, and a separate next audit for associative-action dwgResbufValueKind.
